name: opaque-empty
description: Zero-length opaque run. [WBXML1.3] 5.8.4.6 gives the grammar as `opaque = OPAQUE length *byte`, and mb_u_int32 of zero is one 0x00 octet - never nothing. ASWBXML.EncodeMultiByteInteger loops `while (value > 0)` and so returns an empty array here, emitting 0xC3 with no length at all; the next token is then read as the length and the rest of the document is garbage.
